subject: Billing contact transition and delivery fallback
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@greenwave.io>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, billing@greenwave.io
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: New AP contact + invoice delivery while portal onboarded

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you’re well. We’re finalizing our vendor AP routing for Q4 and would like to move Redwood invoices to our centralized AP queue (ap@greenwave.io) starting with next month’s invoice.

A few constraints from our side:
- We need a visible billing contact on invoices (name + email) for 3-way matching.
- We prefer e-invoice portal delivery, but our SSO provisioning will take ~2 weeks; can you send PDFs to ap@greenwave.io in the meantime?
- VAT evidence: please include VAT registration number on invoices and send any VAT certificates to ap@greenwave.io (separate email).

I’ve attached PO 4472 for reference (PDF). Let me know if you need a dedicated AP contact at Redwood for escalation.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Finance Operations
Greenwave Analytics

Attachment: Greenwave-PO-4472.pdf (application/pdf, 145 KB)

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@greenwave.io>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New AP contact + invoice delivery while portal onboarded

Hi Elena,

Thanks — we can accommodate this. Quick summary of options and proposed short-term flow: 

Short-term (until SSO is set up):
- We’ll send PDF invoice copies to ap@greenwave.io the day invoices are generated.
- Billing contact on the invoice line: Kimberly Park (kimberly.park@redwood.com), Billing Ops, Redwood Inference.

Target (preferred):
- eInvoice portal delivery (recommended) with AP webhook enabled so your system can ingest invoices automatically.

What I need from you to start:
1) Confirm AP email to use (ap@greenwave.io is fine if that’s the centralized inbox).
2) Confirm PO / billing entity and VAT number to place on the document.
3) Preferred remit details (if different from the PO).

I’m attaching our eInvoice spec and a short onboarding checklist so your SSO/IT team can see what we’ll need. Once we have the AP contact and VAT, we’ll schedule a short onboarding call (15–20 min) to provision the portal.

If this works I’ll loop in Ben to enable the webhook for the portal and Marissa for billing config.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-eInvoice-spec.pdf (application/pdf, 230 KB); Portal-onboarding-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 12 KB)

From: ben.carter@redwood.com <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, Elena Ruiz <elena@greenwave.io>
Date: Sat, 25 Sep 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New AP contact + invoice delivery while portal onboarded

Kim / Elena — quick technical note from engineering side:

- We can enable an AP webhook to push invoice JSON to Greenwave’s ingestion endpoint. If Greenwave prefers, we can also keep the legacy PDF push to ap@greenwave.io as a fallback.
- For VAT evidence, we can include the VAT number in the invoice header and attach a VAT certificate (PDF) if provided.
- For the transitional period I recommend the following: automated PDF delivery + webhook disabled until SSO is confirmed. That keeps the manual route simple for your AP team.

If Greenwave can share an ingestion endpoint and a test key, I’ll stand up the webhook in our staging cluster and run an end-to-end test.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Integrations Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Greenwave AP <ap@greenwave.io>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: RE: New AP contact + invoice delivery while portal onboarded

Hi Kimberly / Ben,

Thanks — ap@greenwave.io is the correct inbox. VAT number is GW-VAT-33921 (please include on the invoice header). We can accept PDFs for the next two billing cycles while we complete SSO.

We’ll also provide a test ingestion endpoint by next Tuesday (see HubSpot link to our vendor intake in my signature). For now please send month-end invoices to ap@greenwave.io with Kimberly Park listed as the billing contact.

Regards,
AP Team
Greenwave Analytics

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New AP contact + invoice delivery while portal onboarded

Elena / AP team — thanks for confirming. Plan and next steps: 

1) SCOPE: Redwood will set billing contact to: Kimberly Park (kimberly.park@redwood.com) on all invoices for Greenwave Analytics (entity GW-437).
2) SHORT-TERM DELIVERY: We will send PDF invoices to ap@greenwave.io for the next two cycles (Oct and Nov). Expect the first PDF on 2027-10-01.
3) VAT: We will populate GW-VAT-33921 on the invoice header. If you have a VAT certificate, please send it to ap@greenwave.io and we will attach it on file and include the filename in the invoice metadata.
4) PORTAL ONBOARDING: Ben will stand up a staging webhook once you provide the test endpoint and key. Marissa will coordinate a 15-min SSO provisioning call next week.

Action owners & timeline:
- Elena / Greenwave AP: send VAT cert and test endpoint by 2027-10-03
- Ben (Redwood): test webhook in staging by 2027-10-06
- Marissa (Redwood): SSO provisioning call scheduling (send invite by 2027-09-30)
- Kimberly (Redwood): send Oct PDF invoice to ap@greenwave.io on 2027-10-01

If anything changes we’ll fall back to manual PDF and track via HubSpot (link below). I’ve attached the portal checklist again for your IT team.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
